name: Override Syntax Migrator
blurb: old _append/_prepend/_remove/_${PN} override syntax rewritten to the colon syntax of Honister and later
intro: Rewrites an old-syntax recipe, bbappend, class or conf to the colon override syntax, as the Yocto 3.4 migration guide describes ("Override syntax changes"), optionally followed by the Kirkstone variable renames and the git SRC_URI fixes of the 4.0 migration guide. It implements the documented migration and matches openembedded-core's convert-overrides.py 0.9.3 (and convert-variable-renames.py / convert-srcuri.py) byte for byte on a 150-file corpus of real layers. It marks the rewrites a human should look at: matches inside quoted values and function bodies, override words that run into longer names, old syntax left over because an override name is not on the list, and lines BitBake 2.x will still refuse.

inputs.label: Recipe, bbappend, .inc, .bbclass or .conf
inputs.default:
# meta-acme/recipes-core/acme-agent/acme-agent_1.4.bb  (dunfell 3.1)
SUMMARY = "ACME field agent"
LICENSE = "MIT"
LIC_FILES_CHKSUM = "file://LICENSE;md5=0835ade698e0bcf8506ecda2f7b4f302"

SRC_URI = "git://github.com/acme/agent.git;protocol=git \
           file://acme-agent.service \
           file://0001-fix_x86.patch \
"
SRC_URI_append_imx6ull-acme = " file://board.conf"
SRCREV = "4f1c2d0b9a8e7f6d5c4b3a291807f6e5d4c3b2a1"
S = "${WORKDIR}/git"

inherit cmake systemd

DEPENDS_append = " openssl"
DEPENDS_remove_libc-musl = "libexecinfo"
EXTRA_OECMAKE_prepend_acmeboard = "-DACME_BOARD=ON "
EXTRA_APPEND_FLAGS = "-O2"
TUNE_CCARGS_append_armhf = " -mfloat-abi=hard"
CFLAGS_append_arm = " -mfpu=neon"

SYSTEMD_SERVICE_${PN} = "acme-agent.service"
RDEPENDS_${PN} += "bash ${PN}-conf"
RDEPENDS_${PN}_append_class-target = " iproute2"
FILES_${PN}-conf = "${sysconfdir}/acme"
FILES_${PN}-dev_append = " ${libdir}/cmake"
INSANE_SKIP_${PN} += "ldflags"
PNBLACKLIST[acme-legacy] = "replaced by acme-agent"

do_install_append() {
    install -d ${D}${systemd_system_unitdir}
    install -m 0644 ${WORKDIR}/acme-agent.service ${D}${systemd_system_unitdir}
}

do_install_append_imx6ull-acme() {
    install -m 0644 ${WORKDIR}/board.conf ${D}${sysconfdir}/acme/
}

python do_check_append_list() {
    for p in (d.getVar('PACKAGES') or '').split():
        if d.getVar('RDEPENDS_%s' % p):
            bb.note("pkg %s has runtime deps" % p)
}
addtask check_append_list after do_install

pkg_postinst_ontarget_${PN}() {
    systemctl enable acme-agent
}

examples.title: Dunfell local.conf for an i.MX8M Mini build

input.text:
# conf/local.conf from a dunfell build directory
MACHINE ??= "imx8mm-evk"
DISTRO ?= "fsl-imx-xwayland"
BB_ENV_EXTRAWHITE_append = " ACME_TOKEN"
LICENSE_FLAGS_WHITELIST = "commercial"
IMAGE_INSTALL_append = " htop acme-agent"
IMAGE_INSTALL_remove = "packagegroup-core-x11-sato"
IMAGE_FSTYPES_imx8mm-evk = "wic.bz2 tar.bz2"
EXTRA_IMAGE_FEATURES_append_mx8 = " debug-tweaks"
DISTRO_FEATURES_remove = "x11 wayland"
KERNEL_DEVICETREE_imx8mm-evk += "freescale/imx8mm-acme.dtb"
PREFERRED_PROVIDER_virtual/kernel_imx8mm-evk = "linux-imx"
SSTATE_DUPWHITELIST += "${DEPLOY_DIR_IMAGE}/"

usage: Give the old-syntax file as text and the layer's own override names (MACHINE, DISTRO, SoC families) as overrides; keep renames/srcuri on for a Dunfell -> Kirkstone or later move. The result's texts 'Converted' is the whole rewritten file and 'Diff' the changed lines; the 'Rewrites' table lists each change with its rule, and 'Review' what still needs a human (old syntax BitBake 2.x will refuse, names that look like unknown overrides, matches in values or code). Add suggested override names and run again, as with the script.
sources: Yocto Project Migration Guide, Release 3.4: Override syntax changes (the conversion, package-name overrides, suffixes that are not overrides)
Yocto Project Migration Guide, Release 4.0: Inclusive language improvements (renamed and removed variables) and Fetching changes (branch= and protocol=https on git URLs)
BitBake User Manual, Syntax and Operators: Conditional Syntax (Overrides)
Yocto Project Reference Manual, Variables Glossary: PREFERRED_PROVIDER, SRCREV, PREFERRED_VERSION
Behaviour checked against convert-overrides.py 0.9.3, convert-variable-renames.py 0.1 and convert-srcuri.py 0.1 run as black boxes (150-file corpus byte-identical, plus randomised lines)
